newsitem.title: UK: British air investigator finds dad dead in crash.
newsitem.headline: British air investigator finds dad dead in crash.

text.p: A British air accident investigator called to the scene of a light plane crash discovered that his father was one of the two victims, police said on Thursday.

"It was awful. I wouldn't want anyone to experience what that was like," Damian McConnochie said after finding his father Ian had died when his single-engined Piper Cherokee crashed into the sea off Southport in northwestern England on Wednesday.
"I had a feeling it was him, but I was not sure until I saw the aircraft," said Damian, 21.
His 49-year-old father and another pilot, who both had thousands of hours of flying experience, died in the crash.
"He had never had an accident before in his life, never even scratched the plane. I am totally baffled," said Damian.
